_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - this file is not read from here. Copy it to
this one) and replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/service-topology with the real
path to this checkout. Read hooks/README.md first - it blocks git commit,
git push, docker compose up, live broker and database clients, dependency
installs, and writes outside service-topology/, which will interfere with
ordinary development work in the same session.
Do NOT place this file at .agents/hooks.json inside this checkout itself -
Antigravity auto-loads workspace hooks from there, and
the placeholder script path below does not exist yet.
This hook matters more on Antigravity than on the other hosts: the bundled
custom agents ship with commandExecutionPolicy: auto so that the read-only
scan scripts run without a prompt for every subtree.
